description: This file contains unit tests for asset creation validation in the DataAssetBackend project, using the Xunit framework. It tests various validation rules for API input when creating assets.

classes.name: AssetCreateValidationTests
classes.description: A test class for validating asset creation API input, using Xunit fixtures and asynchronous test methods.

methods.name: Create_asset_requires_requiresParentPseudo_field
methods.description: Tests that omitting 'requiresParentPseudo' results in a 400 BadRequest response.

methods.name: Create_asset_requires_processGroupOtherText_when_processGroup_is_other
methods.description: Checks that when 'processGroup' is 'Other', missing 'processGroupOtherText' causes a 400 BadRequest.

methods.name: Create_asset_requires_parentPseudoAssetId_when_requiresParentPseudo_is_true
methods.description: Ensures that when 'requiresParentPseudo' is true, missing 'parentPseudoAssetId' yields a 400 BadRequest.

methods.name: Create_asset_rejects_nonexistent_parentPseudoAssetId_with_validation_or_db_unavailable
methods.description: Validates that a non-existent 'parentPseudoAssetId' results in a 400 BadRequest or 503 ServiceUnavailable, depending on environment.

methods.name: Create_asset_rejects_parentPseudoAssetId_when_requiresParentPseudo_is_false_with_validation_or_db_unavailable
methods.description: Checks that providing 'parentPseudoAssetId' when 'requiresParentPseudo' is false returns a 400 BadRequest or 503 ServiceUnavailable.
